programme.title: The Doctors

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors highlights the other side of addiction: recovery. Witness the powerful life transformation of a man who lost his legs to heroin. Then, can a breakthrough brain treatment for pain and addiction offer hope to so many sufferers? Then, The Doctors investigates drug addicted healthcare workers who put the patients they are treating at risk. Hear a harrowing story of a mother who contracted a deadly disease at the hands of a drug-addicted hospital worker. Plus, find out how you can protect yourself from becoming a victim of a medical mistake at the hands of a drug-addicted provider. And, learn the key to harnessing hope when things feel hopeless.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors “Race to Erase 10 Years” on a lucky audience member! Just wait until you see The jaw-dropping results! Candle explosion: could it happen to you? People are suing The major cereal companies over “nutritious” and “wholesome” claims! Guest loses 170 pounds but it isn’t enough! Find out what still is weighing her down. The Doctors discusses a new study that claims going vegan leads to depression! Product claims to whiten teeth 6 shades lighter in just 3 days? Does it work or is it 50 shades of disappointment? We’re putting it to The test! Plus, The water bottle danger you haven’t heard!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It's time for another round of the most embarrassing questions! Learn everything you've always wanted to know but were too afraid to ask - no subject is off-limits! And, learn how to get rid of those flabby arms once and for all!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, meet the father who had to have his hands and feet amputated after an extremely rare case of strep throat! programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, a Teen Mom star who thinks she was misdiagnosed with a mental health disorder comes to the show for a second opinion! Plus, the shocking story of a baby born with two noses! Then, Dr. Pimple Popper returns to discuss two gross viral videos: the “grandmother of all blackheads” and a popped blister you have to see to believe! And can you be too fat for fitness? A fitness teacher called out for her weight is here to set the record straight!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Should school nurses administer medicinal marijuana? Nurses debate. Could pain patches be deadly? THE DOCTORS gives must-know information for parents. programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Can a high-tech surveillance company keep your kids safe at school? Attorney and psychologist Lisa Strohman weighs in on the hot-button issue. Neuroscientist Dr. Don Vaughn and attorney and psychologist Dr. Lisa Strohman debate the pros and cons.

programme.title: The Doctors

Learn what to do if you overindulge.
